acceptance: Presto and Trino query-level readiness is confirmed or fixed on a hosted UAT run (satisfied when presto-trino-release-uat-coverage puts them back in a green hosted run), or the check is dropped with evidence.
SingleStore has a recorded live bulk-load result on the hosted runner (the trunk UAT singlestore cells' load phase), or the owner accepts the existing passing cells as that evidence.
context:
Hosted trunk UAT run https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox/actions/runs/42536258036 completed with failure at source 2d796acd59be06ab4b4a1742dda84cff419202b9. The real hosted gate executed 710 selected cells: 702 passed and 8 failed. Passing slices now give real-runner evidence for current Spark, LakeSail, Velox, QuestDB, DataFrame and PostgreSQL-family cells. This is not certification of historical cells excluded from the current matrix; CedarDB, InfluxDB, Presto and Trino have no rows in this run. Counts cover the selected current matrix only; no historical issue is closed by this note. The full run is still red (702/710 passed), so this is not release certification.

description:
Several release-UAT fixes were written without a real hosted run (no Docker, 26 GiB free disk locally). Status of each against hosted runs as of 2026-11-11 (develop c7b75c80bc):
- Spark/PySpark failures from the rc2 shard (Java 25): confirmed fixed; release-uat-env pins Temurin 21 and trunk UAT 42536258036 passed spark 43/43 and pyspark-df 39/39.
- Velox container exit and tmpfs exec fix: Velox is in the trunk UAT matrix (trunk-uat.yml:276) and its cells pass; release-uat-velox-container-exits-20261030 is done.
- SF1 timings measured only on a developer machine: trunk UAT runs 42536258036, 42718296767 and the scheduled runs 42789483182 and 42990393684 execute SF1 cells on the hosted runner.
- CedarDB query-level readiness: CedarDB cells reached query level in release UAT dry run 5 (run 41309974530) and nightly t3:throughput-cedardb passes on scheduled runs; CedarDB is excluded from release-gate-02 and tracked by cedardb-release-uat-coverage.
- Presto and Trino query-level readiness (assumes curl exists in those images, falls back to the old healthcheck if missing): NOT yet confirmed on a hosted release/trunk UAT run; both are excluded from release-gate-03-docker-oltp.yaml (line 16) and tracked by presto-trino-release-uat-coverage.
- SingleStore bulk load: SingleStoreConnectionWrapper no longer exists on develop; singlestore runs in the trunk UAT stage 3 shard 'doris,singlestore' (trunk-uat.yml:278) with the cells passing. No dedicated live bulk-load check is recorded.
- test_write_primitives_overrides_name_singlestore_not_mysql now asserts that the named index operations are singlestore-keyed (tests/unit/platforms/test_athena_singlestore_native_dialects.py:32-37), no longer only non-empty.
